MailLinus01: Hi @,^^Early this morning I found some seeds while walking through the mountains.^^When you live like I do, you learn to appreciate the small gifts nature provides.^^I hope this little snack helps with your work.^^^- Linus.
MailLinus02: Hello friend,^^I found some berries and a mushroom during my morning walk.^^Nature always provides enough for those who know where to look.^^I hope you enjoy them.^^^- Linus.
MailLinus03: Hi @,^^I spent the morning searching for food near the mountains.^^Simple things like these help a lot when days become difficult.^^I thought you might find some use for them too.^^^- Linus.
MailLinus04: @,^^I found these wild onions near the river along with some berries while walking through the forest.^^We don't always need much to live well.^^^- Linus.
MailLinus05: Hello friend,^^Today I wanted to share my good fortune with you. I found many mushrooms during my morning walk.^^I hope you enjoy them, there are many delicious meals you can make with them.^^^- Linus.
MailLinus06: Luck blesses those in need, my friend @. Today I found more mushrooms out in the forest.^^I immediately thought of my good friend, so I left them in your mailbox with this letter.^^Enjoy this delicacy.^^^- Linus.
MailLinus07: @, if you want to become a great forager like me, you must dedicate yourself every day.^^It wasn't easy, but I gathered these mushrooms for you. Of course, I kept some for myself too.^^Come visit me sometime and I'll teach you a few recipes.^^^- Linus.
MailLinus08: @, I finally found these shoots, and I'm so happy that I decided to share them with my good friend.^^As far as food goes, this is one of the finest things a forager can find.^^I also prepared some sashimi this morning.^^Enjoy it well, my friend!^^^- Linus.
MailLinus09: @, my dear friend, I found these fruits during a very cold night in the mountains.^^Few people appreciate the simple gifts of nature the way we do.^^Save some for difficult days.^^^- Linus.
MailLinus10: @ my dear friend!^^When I chose to live far from the town, I didn't know if I would ever need this.^^But nature taught me that the best things only have value when shared with someone special.^^I hope you take good care of this old treasure.^^^- Linus.
